task.title: Fetch from Remotes
task.shortdesc: Download the latest commits and branch information from your remotes without changing your working copy.

context.p: Fetching updates your remote-tracking information (what the and views show), so you can see what is on the remote before you pull. It never merges or changes your files.

step.cmd: Start a fetch in one of these ways:

choices.choice: From the menu or the menu, select to fetch from all configured remotes.
In the view, right-click the node to fetch all remotes, or a specific remote such as origin to fetch only that one.

result.p: The and views update to reflect the latest remote state.
